newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline around steady, barge trade volatile.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline around steady, barge trade volatile.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were around steady on Wednesday but with poor European demand and the difficulty of shipping product transatlantic dampening trade.
Traders said the barge market was being buffeted by two players -- one keen to see prices up, the other looking to sell it lower -- leaving the market volatile in both directions.
Prompt Rotterdam refinery liftings for Eurograde traded at $218.75 and $222 a tonne and were talked in a wide $219/$222 range for much of the morning.

Cargo prices remain supported by an open arbitrage to the U.S. despite the scarce vessel availability to ship product. Cargo offers cif Europe were scarce with anybody having a vessel sending product directly transatlantic.
Eurograde cargoes were notionally valued around $222 cif NWE with fob stems around $10 under this level.
